svg.title: Three core seats, two scaled additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-operating-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three core seats, two scaled additions; subtitle: Base pod is 1 FT + 2 C; scaled pod is 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person in the five-person scaled configuration, not one full-time equivalent. The first three seats form the Conservative and Base pods. The final two seats are scaled additions; contractor hours are scoped separately.; caption: Automation handles routing, evidence indexing, and S2S corrections. Named people still own spend limits, buyer disputes, recording exceptions, and bank reconciliation.; stages: label: Exchange operator — core full-time; value: Own buyers, cash exposure, and daily contribution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own signed buyer terms, Ringba or Retreaver routing configuration, publisher caps, and daily cash exposure. Reconcile settled-call contribution with invoices before increasing media budgets or buyer credit limits.; label: Acquisition specialist — core contractor; value: Own search campaigns, landing pages, and source controls; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Manage Google Ads search terms, geographic targeting, negative keywords, landing-page versions, and S2S conversion corrections. Diagnose CPC spikes using settled cohorts rather than optimizing toward raw call starts.; label: Evidence and reconciliation specialist — core contractor; value: Own call audits, evidence retrieval, and dispute packets; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Sample AI transcript dispositions, retrieve TrustedForm or Jornaya evidence where used, and reconcile duration scrubs. Assemble timestamped dispute packets and match buyer receipts to the settlement ledger.; label: Buyer operations manager — scaled full-time; value: Add live capacity management and counterparty coverage; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this second full-time seat in the five-person scaled configuration. Maintain buyer schedules, backup routes, concentration limits, and collections follow-up while the operator retains portfolio-level spend authority.; label: Automation engineer — scaled contractor; value: Add routing tests, event reliability, and audit exports; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this third contractor in the scaled configuration. Test bid timeouts, webhook retries, idempotent postbacks, access controls, and evidence exports; prevent duplicate billing when asynchronous events arrive out of order.
